summary: Frontend-only verification of the 9 new KNMonthPicker month selectors that replaced native <input type="month">. All 9 were reached through the real UI (admin, manager, designer, sales logins) and all behaved correctly: trigger is a BUTTON showing Indonesian long month ('September 2026'), clicking opens the Radix popover {id}-popover with 12/12 month buttons + prev/next year, selecting a month closes the popover, updates the label, and fires the reload request with period=YYYY-MM. Zero console errors / pageerrors across all screens. Static grep confirms no remaining <input type="month"> anywhere in frontend/src.

ui_bugs.issue: Escape key does not close the modal; overlay keeps intercepting clicks until 'Batal' is pressed (blocked sidebar/tab clicks in automation). Pre-existing, unrelated to month picker.
'RATE BERLAKU' renders 'null%' when no tier rate applies (manager@ / Ayu Permatasari, 2026-09). Should be 0% or '—'.

issues: 'Dari'/'Sampai' still use native browser date inputs (data-testid visits-date-from / visits-date-to, <input type="date">) while the month picker beside them is now KNMonthPicker — visually inconsistent. Out of scope for this session, but ~20+ files still contain type="date" if full migration is intended.

action_items: Optional: migrate remaining native <input type="date"> (starting with visits-date-from/to on the same screen as visits-month) to KNDatePicker for consistency
Optional low priority: wire Escape/overlay-click to close the Set Target modal; fix 'null%' rate label on Sales Force KPI card
critical_code_review_comments: KNMonthPicker keeps `year` in local useState initialised from `value`; if the parent later changes `value` programmatically (e.g. reset to today) the popover year will not follow. Not hit by any current screen but a latent sync bug.
InputTaxView passes onChange={(v) => setPeriod(v || period)} — harmless, but KNMonthPicker never emits an empty value, so the guard is dead code.
